title: 28 U.S.C. § 1407 — multidistrict litigation
summary: Multidistrict litigation coordinates federal actions pending in different districts that share common factual questions. Under § 1407, the Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation can transfer them for coordinated or consolidated pretrial proceedings.

sections.Role in the course: Multidistrict litigation coordinates federal actions pending in different districts that share common factual questions. Under § 1407, the Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation can transfer them for coordinated or consolidated pretrial proceedings.
sections.What to examine: Identify the shared factual questions, the proposed efficiencies, and the distinction between pretrial coordination and trial. Lexecon addresses the statutory duty to remand transferred cases; the chapter also examines management, lead counsel, settlement incentives, and the interests of individual parties.
